reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`cilium_identity_cache_timer_trigger_folds`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The upgrade notes list this only as an added metric, so an operator has nothing to do.

proposed.statement: A new metric, cilium_identity_cache_timer_trigger_folds, is listed under Added Metrics in the 1.17 upgrade notes.
